title: Tottenham in surprise talks to sign Real Sociedad striker Willian José
trail: Tottenham are in surprise talks with Real Sociedad over the striker Willian José
body: Tottenham are in surprise talks with Real Sociedad over the striker Willian José, with José Mourinho desperate for a recognised striker to replace the injured Harry Kane. Son Heung-min and Lucas Moura have been used at centre-forward but Willian José’s role as a target man is seen as vital for Mourinho’s tactics. The Brazilian has a €70m (£59m) release clause after signing a new contract in 2018, and although Tottenham are hoping to negotiate a lower fee for the 28-year-old, the striker will not come cheap as a transfer would leave Real Sociedad short of attacking options. Real Sociedad played Espanyol in the Copa del Rey on Wednesday, with the club announcing shortly before the cup tie that Willian José had withdrawn from the squad and that “the forward has asked to stay out until his situation is clarified”. Before Tottenham’s 2-1 win over Norwich, Spurs had not scored a Premier League goal in open play since Boxing Day, amounting to six hours and 18 minutes of football. Willian José has scored eight league goals in 20 appearances this season, having also played in La Liga with Zaragoza and Las Palmas.
